protocols.measured_return_readout: training-only offset/affine calibration; 102 untouched test timestamps; no current return or internal C/S sensor input at test
protocols.xai4heat: 60/20/20 chronological split per fold; target temperature channels excluded from features; all-valid-range protocol
protocols.flensburg: causal 1/6/24 h measured-supply forecasts; pre-2018 source model and 2017+Q1-2018 local-history model; test from 2018-04-02

evidence_boundary: Only measured temperature targets are validated. Distributed temperature, heat loss, pressure/head, and flow are not field validated by these analyses.
